tosPayment1: A 50% prepayment of the final price is required before I start. The rest is paid after you approve the final version and before you receive the files without a watermark.
tosPayment2: The final price is the base price plus the add-ons you choose. It is fixed once the brief is agreed and only changes if the brief changes.
tosPayment3: Payment methods and currency are discussed in DMs.
tosDeadline1: I give an estimated deadline before we start. It depends on complexity, my current queue and the number of revisions.
tosDeadline2: Deadlines may shift for valid reasons (illness, force majeure, technical issues). I always warn you in advance.
tosDeadline3: Rush orders with a tight deadline are accepted by separate arrangement; a rush fee may apply.
tosRevisions1: Two rounds of revisions at the sketch stage and one at the colour stage are included in the price.
tosRevisions2: A revision is a refinement within the agreed brief. Changing the character, pose, composition or background after the sketch is approved counts as a new job and is paid separately.
tosRevisions3: Revisions are not accepted after the final files are delivered, except for fixing mistakes on my side.
tosRights1: Personal, non-commercial use is included: avatars, wallpapers, posts and gifts.
tosRights2: Commercial use (merch, advertising, games, monetised streams and videos) is only allowed by separate agreement and for an extra fee.
tosRights3: Credit me as the artist when you publish the work — @ishwacha.
tosRights4: I keep the right to post the finished work in my portfolio and social media. If the piece is private (a gift, an NDA), tell me in advance and I will not publish it.
tosRights5: Reselling the artwork and using it in NFTs are not allowed.
tosCancel1: If you cancel before I start, the prepayment is refunded in full.
tosCancel2: If you cancel after work has started, the prepayment is not refunded, as it covers the time already spent.
tosCancel3: I may decline a commission at any stage if the subject falls outside what I draw or if the communication becomes unacceptable. In that case the prepayment is refunded in proportion to the work not done.

tosPrivacyNote: How I handle your data is described in detail in the
privacyIntro: I collect as little as possible — only what is needed to reply to your request and complete the commission. The site does not send the brief to a server: the text is built in your browser and reaches me only when you send it yourself on Telegram or Discord.
privacyData1: From the brief: name (optional), credit nickname (optional), commission description, reference links, desired deadline and the preliminary estimate.
privacyData2: When we talk on Telegram or Discord I see your nickname and whatever you write yourself. The site does not collect your IP address and does not store the brief.
privacyData3: The draft is stored only in your browser. The text reaches me only after you paste it into the chat yourself.
privacyData4: The commission description is required so that I can estimate the work. Name, nickname and references are optional.
privacyWhy1: To reply to your request, agree on the details and calculate the price.
privacyWhy2: To keep the queue in order and not lose our conversation.
privacyWhy3: To answer your questions and discuss the commission in the chat that suits you.
privacyLegal1: Requests, correspondence, agreeing on details and completing the order — Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (pre-contractual relations and performance of a contract).
privacyLegal2: Site security and protecting our correspondence from spam — Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest).
privacyLegal3: If you contact me by email, Telegram or Discord on your own initiative, processing is needed to answer you; where required — on the basis of consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR).
privacyWhere1: The brief is not stored on the site: it stays in your browser and in the Telegram or Discord conversation you send it to.
privacyWhere2: The site is static and hosted on GitHub Pages. A Cloudflare Worker is used only to show available slots; the brief text never reaches it.
privacyWhere3: Only I have access to the conversation.
privacyThird1: Telegram — receiving the brief and our conversation.
privacyThird2: Cloudflare — showing available slots and protecting the site; it does not receive the brief text.
privacyThird4: Google (Gmail) — email for correspondence if you write by email; letters are stored by Google.
privacyThird5: Google Translate — translation of public Telegram posts in the home feed; Google receives your IP address for this. Brief data is never sent there.
privacyThird6: Discord — optional conversation if you prefer Discord; messages are stored by Discord.
privacyTransfer1: Telegram FZ-LLC is based in Dubai (UAE). The European Commission has no adequacy decision for the UAE.
privacyTransfer2: The transfer to Telegram is based on performing your request and the contract, and where applicable on Telegram's standard contractual clauses. The risk that authorities of third countries may access the data cannot be fully excluded.
privacyTransfer3: Cloudflare, GitHub and Discord process data under their own contracts; part of the processing may take place outside the EEA, including in the USA.
privacyCookies1: There are no advertising or analytics cookies on the site.
privacyCookies2: Your browser's localStorage stores the selected language, the brief draft and the post translation cache. You can delete it in your browser settings at any time.
privacyRetention1: Correspondence — while the work is in progress and for up to 12 months after it ends, in case we return to the order. After that I delete it.
privacyRetention2: The brief draft stays in your browser until you clear it or delete the site data. Messages on Telegram and Discord are kept under those platforms' rules.
privacyRetention3: On your request I will delete the conversation unless the work has already started and deletion would prevent completing the order.
privacyRights1: You can ask to see, correct or delete your data — write by email or on Telegram.
privacyRights2: You can request restriction of processing, object to processing based on legitimate interest, and receive your data in a machine-readable format.
privacyRights3: You have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority, for example in your country of residence.
privacyRights4: If processing is based on consent, you can withdraw it at any time. This does not affect processing that has already taken place.
privacyRights5: You can simply not send the brief: then I receive only what any page load inevitably transmits (IP address, browser headers).
privacyChanges1: If this policy changes, I will update the date below. Significant changes will be announced on Telegram.
privacyContact: Questions about your data — by email
